name: Safety Fresh Foods
old_description: HPP is a unique, non-thermal process that kills pathogenic bacteria  (listeria, salmonella, E. coli ) and spoilage organisms (yeast, mold) through high-pressure, water-based technology. It is a USDA/FSIS and FDA-approved, 100% natural process, and is allowed for use on organic and natural products.  It uses pure cold water, and up to 87,000 psi (6,000 bar) to inactivate pathogens and dramatically extend shelf life. No chemicals. No heat. No additives.
about:
Safety Fresh Foods operates from Glendale, Wisconsin, with a high-pressure processing (HPP) facility in Plymouth, Wisconsin. The company installed a state-of-the-art HPP machine to provide non-thermal pasteurization services to food manufacturers.

The company specializes in high-pressure processing, a cold-water technology that applies up to 87,000 psi to packaged foods for a few seconds to several minutes. The process inactivates pathogens such as Listeria, Salmonella, and E. coli without heat, chemicals, or additives, preserving taste, texture, and nutrients. Shelf life typically increases three to ten times compared to untreated products stored at the same temperature. The equipment also supports cheese ripening control, meat tenderization, and flavor infusion.

Safety Fresh Foods serves food and beverage manufacturers, including dairy, meat, and beverage producers, particularly in Wisconsin. The company works with clients on innovation, cost savings, food safety, shelf-life extension, and process improvements. Its HPP service is used for organic and natural products, as well as conventional items, and is approved by USDA/FSIS and the FDA.

The company emphasizes that its non-thermal method eliminates pathogens to prevent recalls, reduces food waste, and enables clean-label, preservative-free products. It positions the technology as environmentally friendly and a way to improve profitability while sustaining the long-term viability of the regional food manufacturing industry.
